summary.text: Casey Weinstein is a member of the Ohio Senate, representing District 28. The Senate's biography says he was first elected to the legislature in 2018, served three terms in the Ohio House, and is Ranking Member of the Armed Services, Veterans Affairs and Public Safety Committee and the Government Oversight and Reform Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Senate's biography says Weinstein graduated from the United States Air Force Academy in 2004 and served on active duty, including as Deputy Chief of Information Assurance at the Space and Missile Systems Center in Los Angeles.
It says he received an MBA from The Ohio State University's Fisher College of Business in 2007.

According to the biography, Weinstein served on the Hudson City Council from 2016 to 2019 and was appointed by Governor DeWine in 2020 to the state's Holocaust and Genocide Memorial Education Commission.
It says that in the Ohio House he championed veterans, education and renewable energy initiatives, and that he is a director at ServiceNow, Inc.
It says he is married to Amanda, an economics professor at The University of Akron, and that they have two daughters and a son.
